notes: Pure public-API Annex C.8 and clause 4.13.3 witnesses use four schema-valid, adapter-owned FOM modules to compare equivalent, conflicting, and omitted Non-Regulated-Grant settings. The two native private preflight cases passed 2/2; the separate installed-package portable CTest/direct gate passed 12/12 each across both callback models. The 2026-11-08 §6.2.13 switches-table follow-up passed 8/8 focused CTests and 8 direct callback-model executions for primary/contract switch-order and Automatic Resign Action scenarios (out/mgw/cpp-tck-clause-6_1-service-spine-mingw-20261107/tck-results/switch-table-20261108.json). Java parity compiles against the API-only JAR, and three focused packaged Umbra JNI runtime scenarios passed (out/java-tck/switch-duplicate-equal-jni-20261021.json, switch-duplicate-order-jni-20261021.json, and switch-duplicate-omitted-jni-20261021.json). The portable cases check only publicly observable Create, joined getNonRegulatedGrantSwitch, Resign, and Destroy outcomes. Other Java providers, private warning text, unrelated switches, TAR policy, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
